name: album-art
title: Album Artwork
summary: Shows cover art next to albums and playlists.
description: Each album and playlist in a list shows a small cover.
details: Albums use the artwork that iTunes or Finder put on the iPod.
Playlists show a custom image, or a collage of the covers of their first four albums.
After a sync, the iPod makes the album pictures one time. Then the lists scroll with no disk access.
requires: Albums: artwork that iTunes or Finder put on the iPod. No other step is necessary.
Playlists: a custom image needs the thumbnail file. Write the file in the Thumbnails section below.
notes: While the wheel moves, a cover that is not in memory shows as a grey square. The cover shows when the wheel stops.
The thumbnail file comes first. If you change a cover in iTunes, write the thumbnail file again.
